artworks.title: An Ornate Ceiling with an Allegory of Spring
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor over graphite on faintly blued-green laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ceiling design. The central feature is a circular medallion with classical motifs and mythological figures surrounded by decorative patterns. The design includes ornate borders separated by gilded lines, creating symmetry and detail. There are fresco-like frames in the corners and other sections with additional figures and ornamental details, reminiscent of neoclassical style. The colors are muted, enhancing the classical theme.

artworks.title: Rustic Watermill in a Gothic Ruin
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a watermill building in a state of disrepair, surrounded by elements of nature and human activity. The background features a distant church and trees, hinting at a village setting. The detailed brushstrokes depict architectural and natural features accurately. The color scheme consists of earth tones, greens, and blues. Figures, including a woman, children, and a dog, are shown near the water, engaging in daily activities. Additional figures can be observed among the trees and by the building, adding to the depiction of rural life against a historical backdrop.

artworks.title: Hudson River, Logging
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, 1903)
artworks.description: This painting shows a body of water in between wooded mountains. On top of the water there are several long wooden logs with people on them. One of the people stands atop a large log, while the other appears to sit or recline. The people both wear hats, and one of them holds a long stick with a pointed end. The water is a vibrant blue, and the logs are in shades of brown, tan, and yellow. The forest behind the water has trees in shades of dark and light green. The sky has clouds in white and gray against a blue background. The brushstrokes in the artwork are loose, and some of the colors bleed into one another.

artworks.title: Wagtail, Eagle, and Turtledove
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is an image of three birds. It shows an eagle in the center, with two smaller birds on either side. The background displays mountains, buildings, and trees. The drawing is detailed, emphasizing the feathers and features of the birds and the scenery. The labels "Aquila," "Parus," and "Turtur" are placed above the birds. Depth is created by layering mountains and clouds in the background. The drawing showcases classical elements and meticulous texture typical of wildlife illustration.

artworks.title: Sawbill, Bittern, Heron and Teal
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three birds near a body of water with reeds. The artwork features two larger birds standing on the ground and one smaller bird sitting on the ground. The background shows tall grass or reeds and bodies of water. The illustration has detailed line work showing texture on the birds' feathers and surrounding foliage.

artworks.title: Double-Wattled Cassowary and Finches
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a black and white illustration of various birds in a landscape setting. The detailed line work depicts the scene from a slightly elevated perspective. Three birds are on the ground, including a large bird with elongated legs and neck, and two smaller birds. In the background, a village is on a hillside with buildings and a water body with a bridge. Figures are crossing the bridge, and two birds are flying in the sky. The engraving uses hatching and intricate line work to show texture and shading.

artworks.title: Falcon and Robin Redbreast or Redstart
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving focusing on three birds in a natural landscape. A large bird, possibly a hawk, is perched on a branch, facing right with intricate feather details. Two smaller birds are also present. The sky has horizontal cloud etchings, with hills and a structure in the background. Buildings with unique roofs, a watermill, and trees are on the right side. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of gray, emphasizing texture and shading typical of engravings.

artworks.title: Hoopoe and Owl
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a print of a bird flying over a distant landscape alongside an owl perched on a branch. The bird on the left is in mid-flight, facing the right. It has stripes on its body and wings, a pointed head, and a long beak. On the right, an owl is perched on a branch that rises from the lower right corner. The owl has dotted feathers on its body and its wings pulled in by its sides. Its beak is slightly hooked, and its head is slightly turned to the left. There are small dark words beside each bird. The background shows a town far below, with buildings, roads, and bridges leading over a winding river. There are people and animals walking across the land and standing in boats on the water. In the background there are distant hills.

artworks.title: Heron and Snipe
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts two birds labeled "Ardea stellaris major" and "Rallus" in intricate detail. The birds are shown in a landscaped area with vegetation, flowers, and textured ground. In the background, there is a town with buildings, spires, and boats near the water. The sky has swirling clouds. The engraving is primarily monochromatic, using varying shades of grey to create depth and texture.

artworks.title: Two Giant Snipes and Two Surf Scoters
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various birds by a body of water surrounded by tall grasses. The drawing depicts a scene with birds in their natural habitat beside a water body with tall reeds or grasses. One large bird with long legs and a long neck stands prominently in the foreground, while several other smaller birds are seen both on land and in the water. The background shows more birds flying in the sky and several more on the water. The illustration showcases detailed plant life, with each blade of grass meticulously rendered. Shadows and textures are created with fine lines and hatching, typical of traditional engraving or etching techniques.

artworks.title: Mallard, Duck, and Swallow
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three birds in a landscape setting. The image includes a duck labeled "Anas" on the left, a swallow labeled "Hirundo" in the center, and another duck labeled "Anas marina" on the right. The background features a landscape with a town in the distance, including church spires, houses, and hills. The scene is filled with grassy patches, trees, and details creating depth and tranquility. The drawing appears to be an etching or engraving, indicated by the fine lines used to portray the birds and landscape.

artworks.title: Great Tit and Starling
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: Two birds, a Parus sylvaticus on the left and a Sturnus on the right, dominate the foreground of the image. The scene is rendered in grayscale with detailed etching techniques, showcasing intricate feather patterns on the birds and texture in the surrounding landscape. In the background, there is a scenic view of rolling hills with a distant village nestled between rocky outcrops, and a bridge spanning a river visible just above the birds. A tree extends up the right side of the image, framing the composition and offering a sense of depth to the landscape.

artworks.title: Peacock and Goose
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The monochrome engraving shows a peacock, a goose, and two ducks by a body of water. The detailed brushstrokes create textures on the birds' feathers and the water's surface. In the background, there is a village with a church and a bridge, surrounded by hills, trees, and a few figures on horseback. The color palette consists of shades of gray and black.

artworks.title: Hawk and Sparrows
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three birds in a landscape. The central focus is a large bird of prey standing on a rocky outcrop. Flanking this bird are two smaller birds on either side; one is perched on the ground, while the other appears to be vocalizing. The background shows rolling hills, a distant castle-like structure, and a vast sky with clouds.

artworks.title: Lapwing, Long Eared Owl, and Goldfinch
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three birds in a detailed landscape. The drawing features a central owl with wide eyes, flanked by two other bird species on either side, standing on a small outcrop of land. The left bird is labeled as "Vanelius avis" and has a tuft of feathers on its head, while the bird on the right is labeled "Auricula." Above, two large butterflies are depicted mid-flight against a backdrop of distant mountains and a small ancient-looking village complete with spires and bridges. The intricate detailing captures a serene setting, with attention to the textures of feathers and the surrounding landscape.

artworks.title: Bustard and Great Crested Grebe
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two birds near water and vegetation. The drawing depicts two large birds with unique features, such as notable necks and detailed plumage. One bird has a tuft on its head. They are surrounded by tall grasses and broad-leafed plants at the water's edge. In the background, there is a windmill, a smoking building, and a ship on the water. The artwork shows intricate line work and a classic illustrative quality.

artworks.title: Three Whooper Swans
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image displays a lake with three swans - one on the shore and two swimming. Ripples are seen in the water. In the background, there are trees, a building, and a mountain. The artwork is in monochrome, created using fine lines and cross-hatching techniques.

artworks.title: Spoonbill and Avocet
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two large birds standing in a landscape with a village in the background. The image shows two distinct large birds named "Platea" and "Recurvirostra" in the foreground surrounded by grass and vegetation. "Platea" has a long neck and straight bill, while "Recurvirostra" has a curved beak. The background includes a river, a village, mountainous terrain, and a sky textured with horizontal lines to represent clouds. The illustration combines detailed outlines and shading to depict the birds and the landscape.

artworks.title: Lark and Two Smaller Birds
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows three large birds labeled as "Alauda," "Passeris species ala," and "Albicida" in a monochromatic color palette. The birds are positioned in the foreground, with the "Alauda" on the left, "Passeris species ala" in the center-right, and "Albicida" at the bottom center. In the background are mountains, buildings, and a river landscape.

artworks.title: Partridge and Eagle
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows an ornate engraving of two birds labeled "Perdix" and "Aquila." The birds are perched on rocky outcrops with foliage, with a branch between them. In the background, there is a detailed village with towers and spires, set against hills and distant mountains. The sky above shows delicate linework to suggest clouds. The engraving uses cross-hatching and fine lines for texture and depth, creating a monochromatic visual effect dominated by shades of gray and black.

artworks.title: Kingfisher and Grey Heron
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of two birds near a body of water in a lush landscape. One bird labeled "Alcedo" perches on a branch over the water, while another larger bird labeled "Ardea" stands in the water among plants. Buildings, including a tower and dome resembling a small church, are visible in the background amid hills and trees. The engraving features precise line work with a monochrome palette of gray and black, depicting mountains and foliage in the distance. The texture is detailed and methodical, emphasizing the birds' feathers, trees' bark, and water's flow.

artworks.title: Toucan and Another Tropical Bird
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image features a black and white engraving of two large birds on the ground surrounded by vegetation. One bird on the left has a large beak similar to a toucan's, while the other bird on the right stands on a flowering branch. The background includes hills, mountains, clouds, and a village with European architecture. The engraving is detailed with fine lines and cross-hatching, emphasizing form and detail without color. The word "Sycophante" is inscribed above the right bird.

artworks.title: Woodpecker and Bunting
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of two birds on a rocky perch. The birds are detailed with fine line work. The scene also includes a landscape with a town, hills, and ships in the distance. The engraving style is characterized by precise lines in a monochromatic palette.

artworks.title: Hoopoe and Linnet
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts a black and white engraving of two birds. On the left is a bird labeled "Upupa" perched on a branch, and to the right is a bird labeled "Acanthis" standing on a leafy plant. The engraving style includes detailed line work and cross-hatching for texture and shading on the birds, tree, and landscape. In the background, there are mountains and a settlement. The scene is framed by a large tree on the left.
